channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: Trump says developing AI is a critical race, downplaying fears
item.description: President Trump continues to support frontier artificial intelligence development, despite industry fears such technology could destroy humanity, casting AI as a critical race against China.
item.content:encoded: President Trump continues to support frontier artificial intelligence development, despite industry fears such technology could destroy humanity, casting AI as a critical race against China.

item.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders says Congress has gotten a 'wake-up call' on AI risks
item.description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders,I-Vermont, about his concerns over the risks of artificial intelligence.
item.content:encoded: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with U.S. Sen. Bernie Sanders,I-Vermont, about his concerns over the risks of artificial intelligence.

item.title: Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to stop attacks on energy sites
item.description: In the face of soaring diesel prices, President Trump claims Ukraine and Russia have agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy sites.
item.content:encoded: In the face of soaring diesel prices, President Trump claims Ukraine and Russia have agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy sites.

item.title: For thousands of Haitians in the U.S., end of protected status brings fear, grief and defiance
item.description: Haitians in the U.S. lost their Temporary Protected Status under Trump's immigration crackdown. Now facing deportation to a homeland wracked by gang violence, disease and extreme poverty, Haitians in Miami are meeting the moment with grief, anger, and courage.
item.content:encoded:
Haitians in the U.S. lost their Temporary Protected Status under Trump's immigration crackdown. Now facing deportation to a homeland wracked by gang violence, disease and extreme poverty, Haitians in Miami are meeting the moment with grief, anger, and courage.

(Image credit: Eva Marie Uzcategui for NPR)

item.title: What the 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5% means for inflation and the Fed

item.title: In Florida, textbook publishers are minimizing or removing climate change coverage
item.description: The words "climate change" are slowly being removed from textbooks in Florida and from the state's education standards.

item.description: Bob Mackie, designer of glitzy costumes for stage and screen, died Monday of pneumonia in Palm Springs, California.
